# victorops_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages an alert rule in VictorOps/Splunk OnCall. Note: The API auto-shifts ranks on create, so rank may drift if managed externally. Consider using ignore_changes lifecycle or managing all rules in Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_alert_rule" "database_alerts" {
  alert_field       = "host_name"
  alert_value_match = "db-*"
  match_type        = "WILDCARD"
  routing_key       = victorops_routing_key.platform_alerts.name
  stop_flag         = false
  notes             = "Route database alerts to platform team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alert_field` (String) The field in the alert to match against (e.g., 'host_name', 'entity_id').
- `alert_value_match` (String) The value pattern to match (supports wildcards or regex based on match_type).
- `match_type` (String) The type of matching: 'WILDCARD' or 'REGEX'.
- `routing_key` (String) The routing key to route matching alerts to.

### Optional

- `annotation` (Block List) Annotations to add or transform on matching alerts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--annotation))
- `notes` (String) Description or notes about this alert rule.
- `rank` (Number) The rank (priority) of this rule. Lower ranks are evaluated first. Note: The API may auto-shift ranks.
- `stop_flag` (Boolean) If true, stop processing rules after this one matches.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (Number) The timestamp when the rule was last updated.
- `last_updated_by` (String) The user who last updated the rule.

<a id="nestedblock--annotation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `annotation`

Required:

- `annotation_type` (String) The type of annotation: 's' (notes/string), 'i' (image), 'u' (url).
- `field_name` (String) The field name for the annotation.
- `field_value` (String) The field value for the annotation.

Optional:

- `flags` (Number) Flags: 0 for annotation, 1 for transformation.
